terms.summary: Room, boarding, and nursing charges are covered up to the limit stated in the schedule per day. Any excess charges must be borne by the insured.
If a room above the eligible limit is occupied, associated medical expenses are paid proportionately. Pharmacy, consumables, implants, and diagnostics are excluded from proportionate deduction.
Intensive care unit charges are payable up to the ICU limit specified in the Policy Schedule.
Admissible claims are subject to the co-payment percentage specified in the Policy Schedule.
Payments for procedures listed in the Policy Schedule are restricted to the amounts stated against each.
Pre-existing diseases are covered after the waiting period stated in the Policy Schedule following continuous coverage.
Specific conditions listed in the Policy Schedule are covered after the stated waiting period.
Items listed as non-medical expenses are not payable unless an optional cover for them applies.
Claims must be supported by the discharge summary, final itemised bill, investigation reports, and implant invoices where applicable.
